notes: Single-section amendment (H.R. 7258 IH, 60 lines) adding paragraph (12) to section 203(a) of the DOE Organization Act (42 U.S.C. 7133(a)). Every figure/cite ('(12)', '42 U.S.C. 7133(a)', '203(a)(12)', subparagraphs (A)/(B)), every entity (State/local/Tribal government, energy sector entity, Secretary of Energy, Assistant Secretaries), and every direction claim (adds/shall/coordination) matches source verbatim; no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity error found. Coverage complete: §1 short title, §2(a)(A) functions list, §2(a)(B) technical assistance, §2(b) coordination all analyzed; no material omission. Two MINOR unsupported qualifiers: 'the Secretary of Energy may assign' (discretionary 'may' + assigner identity describe container statute 203(a), which is not in the bill text) and 'private' energy sector entities ('private' not stated in source). Two likelihoodReason claims (voice-vote passage, awaits Senate) are structural stage/votes[] metadata not in the IH bill text, marked SUPPORTED-via-metadata with empty spans. featured_quotes[] (a CR floor quote) was out of scope — the Congressional Record is not a registered referencedSource and cannot be verified against the bill text.
